items.title: Why AI Companies Are Betting Personality Beats Intelligence
items.summary: Artificial Analysis just made AI personality a measurable discipline — and a walk back through DeepSeek's endearing reasoning traces, the GPT-4o grief riots, Opus 5's insufferable phase, and Muse's meme-able mascot suggests the labs are right to bet that character, not just capability, decides which AI people actually use. Plus: Musk pledges a SpaceX share to every kid in America, the Pentagon dangles export controls, and DHS bans DeepSeek.
